|gr1= Markers

|descr= Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes.
<br>
<br>
''brush'' can be:
* "Solid"
* "SolidFull" (A3 only)
* "Horizontal"
* "Vertical"
* "Grid"
* "FDiagonal"
* "BDiagonal"
* "DiagGrid"
* "Cross"
* "Border" (A2/A3 only)
* "SolidBorder" (OA/A3 only)

|s1= markerName [[setMarkerBrushLocal]] brush

|p1= markerName: [[String]]

|p2= brush: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>"Marker1" setMarkerBrushLocal "DiagGrid";</sqf>
